items.title: OKC Thunder center Thomas Sorber underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure today to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee that developed in the late stages of his return-to-play process. He’s expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks.
items.author: Michael Scotto
items.body_excerpt: OKC Thunder center Thomas Sorber underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure today to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee that developed in the late stages of his return-to-play process. He’s expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks.
